items.title: Lennar (LEN) Opens Three New Communities Across Pennsylvania, Alabama And California
items.summary: Lennar (NYSE:LEN) has opened Venue at Leaf Creek, an active adult community in Hatfield, Pennsylvania, with amenities tailored to 55+ buyers. The builder has also introduced Cherokee Bend near Huntsville, Alabama, offering new single family homes across multiple floor plans. In California, Lennar launched The Farm in San Juan Capistrano, a residential project adding more new construction options in the state.
